notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; enterprise funds (Electric, Water, Sewer) on accrual basis, recorded in business_type as net position. Governmental beginning/ending cash = fund balances (all cash/investments, no liabilities). Transfers: statement Total column prints net Transfers in (out) 70,000 (from Electric Fund, p7). Business-type receipts total computed (operating revenues + interest income); disbursements total 1,684,544 printed on Statement of Activities p2. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (includes capital assets and debt). Detail: General Fund departmental combining schedule (pp14-15, 11 department columns) used instead of the less detailed General Fund budget schedule (p10, not recorded); Street and Grant budget schedules; nonmajor combining schedule per fund (5 funds). No enterprise fund schedules. Sanitation department (statement 'Public works') recorded as utilities in detail. Read pages 1-15 of 15
